name: qa-process
description: Test process + methodology: 12 skills (risk-matrix - the risk-based-testing umbrella with registers, storming, calibration, and coverage mapping in references/ - definition-of-done with adherence auditing, test-strategy-author with risk-based test planning, post-mortem-author, smoke-suite-gate, test-pyramid-balancer, e2e-suite-budget, test-case-ideation-from-story, test-case-from-live-feature with the heuristic test-design models, framework-choice-advisor with vendor evaluation and the tool-selection decision record, attack-surface-test-checklist, test-effort-estimation with the change-shape classifier) and 3 agents (release-readiness-checker, quality-coach - the adversarial DoD adherence auditor - and release-engineer, the runbook conductor that walks a release step-by-step with human gates).
